definitions: A Chinese consumer electronics manufacturer based in Shenzhen, Guangdong. It was founded by Li Bingzhong (Sky Li) on May 4, 2018, who was a former vice president of Oppo.
A brand of smartphones and other smart devices produced by the company Realme.
examples: Realme has quickly become a major player in the smartphone market.
She bought a new Realme phone last week.
